en.t: The kappa ran even faster than a monkey.

units.source_text: 我玩命追着它跑，好几次险些跟丢了。

en.t: I ran after it for dear life and nearly lost sight of it several times.
Several other times I slipped and fell.

units.source_text: 得亏当河童跑到一颗生长粗壮的大橡树下的时候，被一头长着粗壮犄角、眼带血丝的公牛拦住了去路。

en.t: Luckily, when the kappa ran under a thick, sturdy oak tree, a bull with massive horns and bloodshot eyes blocked its way.

units.source_text: 河童一看见公牛，吓得尖叫连连，翻筋头儿一样跃进了高高的竹林丛里。

en.t: As soon as the kappa saw the bull, it screamed again and again in terror and leapt like a somersault into the tall bamboo thicket.

units.source_text: 我心里想着：这次让我逮个正着，太好啦，于是跟着也跃了进去。

en.t: Thinking to myself, This time I have got it, wonderful, I leapt in after it too.

units.source_text: 我没想到是那竟然有个洞穴。

en.t: I had not expected there to be a cave there.

units.source_text: 我的手指头刚刚够着河童光滑的后背脊梁时，却突然掉进了黑乎乎的深渊。

en.t: Just as my fingers reached the kappa's smooth spine, I suddenly fell into a pitch-black abyss.

units.source_text: 人类真是千钧一发的关键时刻也会胡思乱想。

en.t: Human beings really do let their minds wander even at a critical, life-or-death moment.

units.source_text: 我愕然的同时，脑子里闪过上高地的温泉旅馆旁边的那座“河童桥”。

en.t: As I stood there stunned, the Kappa Bridge beside the hot-spring inn at Kamikochi flashed through my mind.

units.source_text: 至于后来发生了什么我一点都不记得了。

en.t: As for what happened after that, I do not remember a thing.

units.source_text: 我只记得摔得眼冒金星，不知何时昏了过去。

en.t: I only remember seeing stars from the fall, and then at some point losing consciousness.
